name: gcob/lara-spec-first
description: A Spec-First API framework and integration layer for Laravel. Define your contracts with OpenAPI, generate stubs for AI, mock endpoints with Faker, and bridge legacy code.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest test suite. Runs at 512M, like `analyse`: tests/Conformance/KnownParserBugsTest.php reads a large stderr back from a child process, and PHP's common 128M default fails it with a fatal that has nothing to do with the change under test. Runs with assertions on (-d zend.assertions=1): CI's PHP ships them off and a contributor's usually has them on, and a suite that runs differently in each passes in one and fails in the other. The -d sits here because Composer reads `composer test -d` as its own working-dir option.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the test suite with a coverage report. It runs `test` with `--coverage`, so it gets the same settings.
scripts-descriptions.artisan: Run an Artisan command inside the Workbench application: `composer artisan -- route:list`. A package has no artisan binary of its own; Testbench provides one.
scripts-descriptions.format: Apply Laravel Pint formatting, then reflow docblock prose to the .editorconfig column limit.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Report Pint formatting issues and docblocks that need reflowing, without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.format:docblocks: Reflow docblock prose to the .editorconfig column limit. Pint has no rule for it, so scripts/format-docblocks.php does it; `composer format` runs it after Pint.
scripts-descriptions.format:docblocks:check: List the PHP files whose docblocks need reflowing, without writing, and exit non-zero when there are any. Also warns, without failing, about each cramped @param, @return, @throws or @var. The pre-commit hook runs it on the staged files, and `format:check` runs it on the whole codebase.
scripts-descriptions.format:docblocks:report: List every cramped @param, @return, @throws or @var, the worst first, with a total and the share of described tags. A tag is cramped when its description has fewer columns left than `docblock_min_description_width` in .editorconfig. Never fails.
scripts-descriptions.format:md: Reflow Markdown prose to the .editorconfig column limit and align tables. Runs Prettier outside the PHP container, since the image carries no Node.
scripts-descriptions.format:md:check: Report which Markdown files need reformatting, without changing them.
scripts-descriptions.diagrams: Render every PlantUML source under docs/diagrams/ to the SVG committed beside it. Runs PlantUML outside the PHP container, since the image carries no Java.
scripts-descriptions.diagrams:check: Report which committed diagrams no longer match their source, without writing. This is what catches a diagram edited and not rebuilt.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every pre-pull-request check: formatting, static analysis, tests.
scripts-descriptions.check:lowest: Install the Laravel floor composer.json declares exactly (security blocking off for that install), run the same checks against it, then restore the newest. Fails when Composer cannot install that floor. Development tooling is left alone.
scripts-descriptions.build: Rebuild the Workbench application (assets, database, migrations).
scripts-descriptions.serve: Serve the Workbench application on the PHP development server. Binds 0.0.0.0 so it is reachable from outside the Docker container; running natively, this also exposes it on your local network.
